_comment: THUGPRO compatibility for the THPS4 level ports (tools/thps4_levels). Each entry is registered in README.md here (TP-20 ... TP-29). Online a level is known only by its load script's checksum (messages 0x46 / 0x33): these make our level structures agree with THUGPRO's own THPS4 ports where THPS4's own names can't; TP-22 ... TP-29 are THUGPRO's hand edits of its ports (thps4_levels/thugpro_edits.ts). Read by tools/compat/compat.ts; `thps4_levels.ts convert --compat none` leaves all of it out.

net_nodes._source: THUGPRO's installed data\pre\<level>_scripts.prx node arrays, extracted by `node tools/thps4_levels/thugpro_compare.ts --extract-thugpro` (places only: pos = THUG2's Pos axes)
